Definition: to pluck off, i.e. divest, eject or drop
BiblicalUsage: 1) to slip off, drop off, clear away, draw off; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to slip or drop off; 1a2) to draw off; 1a3) to clear away; 1b) (Piel) to clear out completely, clear entirely
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
